families.replacement: microsimulator-scene-v1 rods and the independent viewer
families.reason: The typed scene preserves rod geometry, stable identity, lineage and scalar presentation fields without renderer-owned simulation state.

families.replacement: microsimulator-scene-v1 signal grids and viewer slices
families.reason: The typed scene preserves complete channel-major signal fields and boundary geometry rather than exposing integrator arrays.
No bundled model selects spherical cell morphology, and the rod-cell engine has no spherical cell state. Typed sphere constraints remain supported independently.
The renderers require polygon nodes, walls and ad hoc cell signal attributes from a plant model absent from the repository and engine.
The renderer derives image offsets from changing collision-grid bounds instead of a declared periodic cell domain; signal-grid periodic boundaries remain supported.
This is a mutable CLBacterium broad-phase bin debug overlay, not a biological mesh or checkpointed simulation feature.
The renderer requires external mesh and regulator object graphs that no bundled model constructs and no MicroSimulator checkpoint represents.
